title: ShineMnemos
subtitle: Memory your agent cannot skip: every answer passes the knowledge graph and returns a verdict.
description:
## What it does

ShineMnemos is a grounded memory layer for AI agents: every answer must pass through the knowledge graph (grounded by default — no pre-pass, no credit) and comes back with a verdict (grounded / partial / ungrounded) plus the sentences the model made up. Every fact passes a truth gate on write (six checks, stored at 4 of 6), recall reads provenance back, and every pass lands in an append-only journal. Open source (Apache-2.0), Python standard library only, self-host free.


## Best for

- Agents that must not emit unverified facts and need the verdict as a field.
- Teams that want memory as one SQLite file — copy, diff, delete.
- Developers who want graph-first answers: memory_answer returns the answer from the graph with zero generation tokens, or llm_required.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/payg/quote` — Pay-per-call checkout: N memory ops at 0.0035 USDC each (intro price, -30%), USDC on Base.
- `POST /api/plans/{id}/challenge` — Plan checkout: Free / Solo $19 / Pro $49 / Team $149 / Scale $499 per month (annual -40%), USDC on Base.
useCase: Grounded memory for AI agents: write through a truth gate, recall with provenance, audit every pass. Paid plans or pay-per-call in USDC on Base.
